name: Nusretiye Camii
source: Built for the Istanbul 3D map (Grok Bot, 4 Nov 2026) on the OSM outline w498861882 (© OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL). Figures and sources: data_pipeline/nusretiye/README.md; unpublished heights pixel-measured from reference photos (yaklaşık). Present-day state; toy style. Shape references never used as textures.

anchor.what: model origin = main dome centre, ground level

rotation_meaning: compass bearing of the model +X axis (model is in map axes: +X east, +Z south)
ground: y = 0 (flat); the map adds terrain height at the anchor only

heights_m.base: stone base (subasman) to 3.2 m above the street (yaklaşık)
heights_m.harim: harim block ≈20.6 m square (≈15.5 m inside), walls to 18.2 m, great-arch tympana to 21.4 m (yaklaşık)
heights_m.drum: drum r 8.3 m (Ø≈16.6 m outside for the Ø≈15 m dome) 21.4-27.6 m, 16 windows (pixel-measured, yaklaşık)
heights_m.dome: crown ≈32.8 m above the street (sources: ≈33 m from the ground), alem above (yaklaşık)
heights_m.minarets: 2 fluted minarets ≈50 m above the street, şerefe at ≈27.5 and ≈35.5 m, shaft Ø≈1.9 m (pixel-measured from refs_nusretiye/nusretiye_01.jpg, yaklaşık) [doğrulanmadı]
heights_m.turrets: 4 weight turrets to ≈28 m incl. finials (yaklaşık)
heights_m.wings: side wings / sultan pavilion to 12.2 m (yaklaşık)

parts: harim block with four great arches
side wings / sultan pavilion with colonnade
2 thin fluted minarets with 2 şerefe each
footprint_note: map metres; map buildings under it are dropped
licence: model: Doğancan Işık project; no third-party models or textures; outline © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL)
